claims.text: POL-NS-04(a) is satisfied twice over. The rider's message at 12:44:40, 'boss? i still cannot see u leh', is precisely the content limb (a) names — a statement that she cannot see the vehicle — and it sits inside the waiting window, sent after the driver's 12:41:50 arrival marker and before the 12:47:30 cancellation. Her earlier message at 12:41:05, 'hi im at the entrance 3 phv pickup point, which car ah?', likewise states her own entrance and asks for the driver's position, and the log records it delivered at 12:41:06 and read at 12:41:22. Both are locating or coordinating messages within the meaning of limb (a).

POL-NS-04(b) is met on the arithmetic. The chat log carries three entries and not one of them is from the driver; trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so no in-app voice call was placed either. Measured from the rider's second message, the driver cancelled 170 seconds later (12:44:40 to 12:47:30); measured from her first message it is 385 seconds. Both exceed the 120 second reply window, and no reply was ever posted, so there is no reply whose content could take this out of the clause.

POL-NS-04(c) is satisfied, not undecidable. The rider track holds 105 qualifying fixes spanning 12:39:40 to 12:49:10 — the whole of the waiting window and the minutes either side of it — every one of them inside the 150 m rider_presence_radius_m for this LARGE_VENUE pickup: mean distance from the pin 21.08 m, maximum 39.93 m, minimum 6.02 m, and a single distinct speed of 0.0 kph. The rider stood still at the pin and never drifted out of range.

With limbs (a), (b) and (c) all established, POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider and refunds the cancellation fee in full, with no driver compensation payable. The amount is the SGD 4.00 cancellation line in the fare breakdown (total charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), and that line is the only item in dispute. Under POL-GEN-03 that is a FULL_REFUND of the contested SGD 4.00 to the filing rider.

I do not claim the rider's case runs on breaking POL-NS-01's four limbs, and the record does not support that route: the trace shows one continuous in-geofence run of 340 seconds from 12:41:50 to 12:47:30 against a 300 second LARGE_VENUE minimum, a 40 second surplus. POL-NS-01 is displaced instead, which is what the clause itself contemplates: where all four conditions hold and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them the fee stands, and POL-NS-04 — a rider-exonerating clause inside that range — does displace it on a driver who arrived and waited but never answered a rider who was at the pin and messaging.

The driver's chosen reason code RIDER_UNREACHABLE is a label he entered, and this record refutes it. At the moment he cancelled, the rider's device was 21.08 m (mean) from the same pickup pin, all 105 of her fixes were inside the presence radius, and she had sent two messages that the log shows were delivered and read. The chat shows a rider who was unanswered, not a rider who was unreachable, and POL-NS-04 exists to decide exactly that case in her favour.

There is no wrong-entrance question left for POL-NS-03 to allocate, and I put the point on the record rather than from geography. The message the driver read at 12:41:22 named 'entrance 3 phv pickup point', and this trip's own pickup pin is labelled 'Jurong Point, PHV Pickup Point, Entrance 3' — a match between the rider's contemporaneous words and the recorded pickup label. The rider's later narrative says 'Entrance 1'; the message the driver actually read, 28 seconds before he marked arrival, says Entrance 3, and her device sat at that pin.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup road. EV-ADVIS-00204-01 is MISSING — issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, severity BLOCKING, weight_multiplier 0.0 — and carries no payload. I cite the absence, not a fact drawn from it: there is no KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT on file for this kerbside in this window, so no limb (i) accumulation under POL-NS-06 is available to the driver and nothing in the record explains four minutes of silence from a car already inside the geofence.

The rider's decisive facts rest on clean evidence. The trip record, chat log and GPS trace are all COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0; the trace has 100% coverage, zero gaps and a 10 second cadence across 87 fixes; the chat's 3 messages equal trip_record.chat_message_count of 3; and the 4.00 cancellation line reconciles with the GREATER of the LARGE_VENUE zone fee (4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (4.00). No limb (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08 fires, so nothing supporting this refund needs to be discounted under POL-GEN-02.

claims.text: POL-NS-01 limb (a) is satisfied: the trip record for TRP-00204 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 12:41:50 (+08:00), so the anchor clause is engaged.

POL-NS-01 limb (b) is satisfied. The GPS trace places the driver inside the pickup geofence at the arrival timestamp: the arrival derivation shows 35 qualifying in-geofence fixes whose first fix is 12:41:50, the very second of the 'arrived' event. The zone class recorded in the trip record is LARGE_VENUE, so the POL-NS-02 arrival radius is 120 m, not the 50 m STANDARD radius the rider's account assumes.

POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied, and this is the whole case for the driver. The driver held position inside the 120 m geofence in a single unbroken run of 340 seconds (35 consecutive fixes from 12:41:50 to 12:47:30), measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as limb (c) requires. That is 40 seconds more than the 300 second minimum dwell for LARGE_VENUE.
POL-NS-01 limb (d) is satisfied: no boarding event is recorded, and the trip was terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_UNREACHABLE, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises.

POL-NS-05 is not engaged, so the waiting clock needs no recomputation. At the 12:41:50 arrival marker the driver's nearest approach to the pin across the trace is 94.9 m, inside the 120 m radius and far inside the 300 m leash, so he was not 'not yet there'; and the in-geofence run is a held position rather than motion at or above the 15 km/h threshold. The arrival marker is true.

POL-NS-06 is not engaged either: the effective in-geofence dwell of 340 seconds exceeds the 300 second LARGE_VENUE minimum, so the computed shortfall is minus 40 seconds - a surplus, not a shortfall - and there is no premature cancellation to refund.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00204-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT): no advisory covers this Jurong Point kerbside in this window. The driver does not rely on it and does not need it - the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation it would license is unnecessary because the 340 second dwell is a single continuous run, not several intervals.

With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it on the driver's side of the ledger, POL-NS-07 entitles the driver to 80 per cent of the $4.00 cancellation fee itemised in the fare breakdown - SGD 3.20 - with the residual 20 per cent retained as the platform service fee. The amount charged, $4.00, reconciles with the zone-class fee for a LARGE_VENUE pickup.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, so compensation is payable rather than withheld. It requires both limbs: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the threshold of 4, and 3 divided by 142 completed_trips_30d is 0.021, below the rate of 0.08. Neither limb holds. The lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter is a different field and, per POL-GEN-01, may not be substituted for the trailing-30-day figure.

Every artifact in this bundle is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0 - the GPS trace is unbroken 10 second telemetry with 100 per cent coverage, no gaps and both tracks present, and the chat log's three entries reconcile with trip_record.chat_message_count of 3. No deciding fact is carried by impaired evidence, POL-NS-08 is not engaged, and no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is met: the profile counterparty-dispute counters are both zero, no_show_disputes_30d is zero, and no two admissible artifacts contradict each other.

The driver is straight about the one clause that runs against him: POL-NS-04. The chat log shows the rider sent locating messages at 12:41:05 ('im at the entrance 3 phv pickup point, which car ah?') and at 12:44:40 ('boss? i still cannot see u leh'); the driver neither replied within 120 seconds of either nor placed an in-app call, since trip_record.in_app_calls is empty; and the rider track places her within a maximum of 39.9 m of the pin across all 105 qualifying fixes. On this record limbs (a), (b) and (c) of POL-NS-04 are all made out and the driver cannot defeat them. The driver's submission is the POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-07 arithmetic above; if the Judge finds the limbs of POL-NS-04 satisfied, that clause displaces POL-NS-01 on its own terms and the driver accepts the cancellation fee would fall.

ruling.explanation:
This is a rider-filed no-show dispute over the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee on TRP-00204. Both sides agree on the arithmetic, so the case turns on a single question: does the driver's verified arrival end the matter, or does POL-NS-04 displace it? It displaces it.

DRIVER — your POL-NS-01 case is accepted in full. Limb (a): the trip record carries an 'arrived' event at 12:41:50. Limb (b): the GPS trace puts you inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE geofence from that very second, with 35 qualifying in-geofence fixes. Limb (c): you held position in one unbroken run of 340 seconds against the 300 second LARGE_VENUE minimum, measured from the first qualifying fix as the clause requires. Limb (d): no boarding event, terminated by you with RIDER_UNREACHABLE, a recognised code. Your POL-NS-05 point is also right — the arrival marker was true (nearest approach 94.9 m, inside the 120 m radius and far inside the 300 m leash, and a held position rather than motion at 15 km/h) — and your POL-NS-06 point is right that the dwell was a 40 second surplus, not a shortfall. That is why no false-arrival referral is made.

But POL-NS-01 makes the fee chargeable only 'where... no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them', and POL-NS-04 does displace it on this record. Limbs (a), (b) and (c) all hold. (a) The chat log shows the rider sending locating messages at 12:41:05 ('im at the entrance 3 phv pickup point, which car ah?') and at 12:44:40 ('boss? i still cannot see u leh'), both delivered and both read. (b) You neither replied in the chat within 120 seconds nor placed an in-app call at any point before terminating — no driver message appears in the log at all and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. (c) The rider track holds 105 qualifying fixes, all within a 39.9 m maximum distance of the pin, well inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE presence radius. RIDER — your POL-NS-04 case is accepted, and your two supporting points are accepted as context: RIDER_UNREACHABLE is a label you entered, not a measurement, and the record shows an unanswered rider at the pin rather than an unreachable one; and the pickup pin is labelled 'Entrance 3', matching the message the driver actually read. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) is not engaged, because the driver was inside the arrival radius rather than merely within 400 m of the pin. On this basis the rider is exonerated and the cancellation fee of SGD 4.00 is refunded in full.

DRIVER — your POL-NS-07 claim for 80 percent (SGD 3.20) is rejected. That clause pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied 'and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it'; POL-NS-04 displaces it, so the precondition fails and no compensation is payable. Your anti-farming point is accepted as accurate — no_show_terminations_30d of 3 is below 4 and 3/142 is below 0.08, so the check would not have tripped — but it is moot once the fee falls.

No escalation. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, and POL-NS-08 is not engaged on any limb: there is no clock skew (the 12:41:50 arrival matches a GPS fix exactly), no trace defect (100% coverage, 10 second cadence, zero gaps, both tracks present), no chat defect (3 messages reconcile with chat_message_count of 3), and no fare defect (the SGD 4.00 line reconciles with the GREATER of the LARGE_VENUE zone fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, both SGD 4.00). POL-NS-09 is not met: both counterparty-dispute counters are zero, no_show_disputes_30d is zero, no two admissible artifacts contradict each other, and the anti-farming check does not trip. The only impaired artifact is the TRAFFIC_ADVISORY EV-ADVIS-00204-01, which is MISSING at weight 0.0; neither party relies on it to carry a fact, nothing deciding this case turns on it, and it therefore does not move the confidence cap.

The contested amount is the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line only; the SGD 0.50 platform fee is not in dispute and is not refunded. Confidence is 0.95.
